The lead endpoint is the total average effect of receiving t=1 rather than t=0 on y, identified using the backdoor criterion with 'c' as the adjustment set [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.endpoint_id, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.adjustment_set.0]. This effect is estimated by comparing units using treatment propensity estimated from the adjustment set [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimator.in_words].

The conditional identifying assumptions for this endpoint are consistency, no interference, explicit graph relationships, and that every omitted identification-relevant edge is a conditional graph assumption [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.0, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.1, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.2, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.3]. Specifically, it assumes unconfoundedness: if there is an unobserved common cause (U) of treatment and outcome, then the probability of the outcome given treatment, 'c', and U is the same as the probability of the outcome given treatment and 'c' [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.identification_certificate.symbolic].

This run was performed on 1200 frozen rows [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.support.by_contrast.1_vs_0.source_row_ids.count].

Several alternative designs were excluded because they do not serve the requested target average effect, or their configurations are not activated by the supplied context [context.admission.endpoints]. For example, 'iv.wald_late', 'mediation.linear_nie', 'mediation.linear_nde', and 'adjustment.linear_conditional' were excluded because they do not serve the requested target average [context.admission.endpoints.3.reason, context.admission.endpoints.8.reason, context.admission.endpoints.9.reason, context.admission.endpoints.10.reason]. Other instrumental variable and frontdoor designs were excluded because their configurations are not activated by the supplied context [context.admission.endpoints.4.reason, context.admission.endpoints.5.reason, context.admission.endpoints.6.reason, context.admission.endpoints.7.reason]. The 'structural.zero' design was excluded because its configuration is not activated by the supplied context [context.admission.endpoints.11.reason].

It is important to distinguish between durable facts and hypothetical study accounts. The current analysis used a frozen admitted context [run.context_policy]. The correction you made in user:turn:13, stating that baseline 'x' affects treatment uptake as well as 'y', is a durable fact [col:x.feeds_treatment]. However, the hypothetical scenario you requested in user:turn:15, where baseline 'x' did not affect treatment uptake, was applied only to an isolated context copy for that specific 'what if' run and did not change durable memory [run.what_if, run.context_policy].

Passing diagnostics does not establish causal assumptions [interpretation:across.all.caveat:1]. For instance, the balance check on 'c' was a soft pass, indicating a standardized mean difference of 1.32 between arms before adjustment and 0.01 after weighting [check:d2e73a51a9f8d.1_vs_0.balance.c]. Sensitivity analysis shows that the estimate for this design ranges from -1.25 to 4.87 under simulated unobserved confounders [sensitivity:d2e73a51a9f8d.1_vs_0.add_unobserved_common_cause.detail].

The lead endpoint is 'total.backdoor' [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.endpoint_id], which estimates the average total effect of receiving t=1 rather than t=0 on y by comparing units using treatment propensity estimated from the adjustment set [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimator.in_words]. This design adjusts for 'c' [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.adjustment_set.0]. The conditional identifying assumptions for this design are consistency, no interference, explicit graph relationships, and that every omitted identification-relevant edge is a conditional graph assumption [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.0, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.1, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.2, design:d2e73a51a9f8d.estimand.assumptions.3]. It also assumes unconfoundedness, meaning that if there are unobserved common causes of treatment and outcome, then the probability of the outcome given treatment, 'c', and unobserved confounders is the same as the probability of the outcome given treatment and 'c' [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.identification_certificate.symbolic]. The frozen row count for this run is 1200 rows [design:d2e73a51a9f8d.support.by_contrast.1_vs_0.source_row_ids.count].
